G. Recursive-repr ownership
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _group_key(
  occurrence: _ContributionOccurrence,
) -> tuple:
  return (
    type(occurrence.proof_step.conclusion),
    repr(occurrence.proof_step.conclusion),
    occurrence.provider_keys,
  )
